name: erc5564-stealth-payments
description: ERC-5564 Scheme 1 stealth payment system with separated viewing/spending keys, scanner, recovery, CLI, and local-chain demo

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:client
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:contracts && vitest run test/crypto.test.ts test/identity-keystore.test.ts test/scanner.test.ts test/architecture.test.ts test/recovery.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run test/e2e.test.ts test/cli.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:contracts && vitest run
